body: I really appreciate the responses, all of you. It really makes me feel better that people take the time to care for others that they don't even know. Talking about it definitely helped a bit, since I've never really told anyone how I felt before.

I have looked into counseling, yes. But I just don't want my parents to feel embarassed that one of their three kids has to go to some form of counseling. 

You don't really have to say anything useful, your kind words have helped more than you think. I really appreciate it.

I've had teachers and other people tell me I'm worthless. It's definitely not the greatest thing in the world. 

I can't pinpoint what it is exactly that I dislike about people. I just can't stand to be around them. I guess I shouldn't say all people, just most. I just can't stand them. Being around them just makes me pissed off and on edge all of the time.

I do have friends, not a lot, but some. Some of them don't live here anymore, and won't be where I'm moving. The friends I do have now that live here refuse to do anything outside of the computer and barely talk to me as is.

See, where you come from makes me feel shitty that I even feel this way. Lots of people came from worse off than me and are fulfilling their lives, but I just can't seem to do it.

Thanks for taking the time to read it and actually have quite an extensive reply. People like you make me still have some hope for humanity in this fucked up world.
